# Island Dream Collective — Bali Villa Management

> Boutique villa management company covering Bali: Canggu (including Berawa), Uluwatu, Seminyak, Ubud, Sanur, Jimbaran and Nusa Dua.

## About
Island Dream Collective (IDC) is an Australian-owned boutique villa management company based in Bali, Indonesia. Founded by Steve and Tara Hawley, IDC specialises in managing luxury private villas for overseas owners, handling everything from bookings and guest communications to cleaning, maintenance and owner reporting.

## Services
- Full villa management: a flat 20% fee on the revenue received after booking-platform commissions (Airbnb, Booking.com), no setup costs. Cleaning supplies, maintenance and other third-party costs are passed through at cost.
- Fee example: on a US$1,000 booking where the booking platform keeps US$170, US$830 reaches the villa and the 20% fee is US$166 (16.6% of the booking). The fee is never charged on money the platform keeps. See https://www.islanddreamcollective.com/services.html#fee-example
- Multi-platform listing (Airbnb, Booking.com, direct booking)
- Guest communications and check-in/check-out management
- Cleaning, linen and maintenance coordination
- Owner dashboard (hostOPZ, https://hostopz.com) with live bookings, revenue, itemised expenses with receipts and monthly owner statements
- Automatic competitor price checks: your rate is compared with similar nearby villas on Airbnb, for fixed dates and for 30, 60 and 90 days ahead
- Monthly (long-term) rental management
- Buyer's service for people buying a villa in Bali: zoning, title, lease and permit checks
- Help for owners switching from another manager: a planned handover, existing staff can stay, and the Airbnb listing and reviews are kept where possible with the owner added as co-host (https://www.islanddreamcollective.com/switching-villa-manager.html)
- Furnishing and styling consultation

## Managed Properties
- **Casa de Loto** — 2-bedroom private pool villa, Canggu, Bali
- **Unite By The Sea** — 4-bedroom villa, Pecatu, Uluwatu, Bali
- **Temple of Tides** — 1-bedroom loft villa with plunge pool, Nyang Nyang, Uluwatu, Bali
